messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@searchco.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Certification request: Pinecone adapter for reseller pilot

Hi Hannah,

Hope youre well. Quick intro  Im Lina, PM for integrations at SearchCo. Were preparing a reseller pilot where our managed search product will route embeddings to customer indexes hosted in Pinecone. To support Redwood customers we built an adapter (attached) that speaks the Pinecone vector API and falls back to S3 for cold queries.

High level asks:
- Can Redwood certify this adapter for use with your Hosted/Dedicated customers (security, perf, and fallthrough)?
- What documentation/artifacts do you need from us to complete certification?
- Can we get a tentative timeline for certification and an internal sandbox test window?

Attachments: searchco_pinecone_adapter_v1.2.zip, integration-test-plan.pdf, perf-report-10k-queries.csv

Wed love to get a short call with your integrations or partner-ops folks this week. Proposed times: Tue 10/6 10am PT or Wed 10/7 9am PT.

Thanks,
Lina Park
PM, Integrations | SearchCo
lina@searchco.ai


From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina@searchco.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Certification request: Pinecone adapter for reseller pilot

Hi Lina  thanks for the package and the clear ask. Looping in Ben (integrations) and Vanessa (partnerships) so we can triage technical + commercial items.

What we need to run a basic certification pass (high priority):
- Security: architecture diagram, authentication model (service-account or API-key), data residency notes, DPA pointer (if any).
- Functional: adapter README, supported Pinecone versions, failure modes (how does the S3 fallback behave), and a sample dataset + expected results.
- Tests: integration-test-plan.pdf looks good; add automated test scripts (pytest or similar) we can run in our sandbox.
- Performance: end-to-end perf report (p95 tail, throughput), ideally with 10k query traces (we got perf-report-10k-queries.csv).
- Observability: logs/metrics names and a short map to our tracing fields so we can correlate calls.

Technical targets wed like to validate during certification:
- p95 latency <= 150ms for <1k token embeddings (hosted -> pinecone path)
- Fallthrough to S3 within 200ms additional overhead
- Proper 429/backpressure handling and retry/backoff semantics

Proposed next steps:
1) Well review attachments and run the automated tests in our sandbox (give us 48-72 hours).
2) Ben and I will produce a short cert checklist and send any follow-ups.
3) If all green, Vanessa will scope reseller terms & trial credits.

Call: Tue 10/6 10am PT works for us. Ive added a provisional link: https://cal.com/hannah-steph-call/2026-10-07-10am

If you can send a short one-page security summary (esp. auth and data retention), thatll speed things up.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Certification request: Pinecone adapter for reseller pilot

Hannah  quick tech questions after skimming the adapter bundle: 
- Index schema: are vectors single dense arrays or embeddings + metadata? If metadata-heavy, well need to validate our routing keys.
- Sharding/namespace behaviour: does adapter map Redwood customer -> Pinecone namespace 1:1 or use a tenant prefix? Weve had issues previously when adapter used a shared namespace with prefixes because of cross-tenant caching.
- Cold-tier strategy: the perf report suggests S3 fallback is object-based (one object per doc). Can SearchCo confirm object size distribution and expected hit ratio? If objects are large, S3 latency could spike.

Ill try to run the tests in our sandbox tonight. If the integration tests include a small synthetic dataset (1k vectors) we can baseline p50/p95 quickly.

Ben
Staff SWE, Integrations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Thanks Hannah  flagged a couple commercial items: 
- Revenue share: SearchCo proposed a 70/30 split in their initial note. Id like to propose a performance-tranching model instead: 60/40 base with upside for latency/reliability SLO attainment.
- Trial credits: recommend offering 90 days of $5k credits for pilot customers to drive initial usage; we can tie eligibility to certification completion.
- Legal: we need a DPA + data processing details before any reseller deal is signed. Please loop legal if we get a go.

Lets hold pricing off the initial certification; we should surface the typical commercial terms for transparency but finalize after a green technical pass. Ill draft a short commercial memo if Ben/Hannah confirm the technical vectors.

Vanessa Ortiz
